WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.IsHoliday,
        f.DateKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_total
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY
        d.IsHoliday,
        f.DateKey
),
bucket_avgs AS (
    SELECT
        IsHoliday,
        avg(day_total) AS avg_daily_sales
    FROM daily_sales
    GROUP BY IsHoliday
)
SELECT
    (maxIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'Yes') - maxIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'No')) * 100.0
        / nullIf(maxIf(avg_daily_sales, IsHoliday = 'No'), 0) AS holiday_vs_regular_pct
FROM bucket_avgs
